publication_commit_identity: Obtain the actual pushed commit from the user startup prompt or the branch tip; excluded here to avoid a self-referential commit hash.

evidence_bundle.scope_policy: The eight explicit Q32/F64 bundle scopes are complete regular-file snapshots. Compiler/SDK installations and out-of-scope historical raw (including R1/M2 independent-screen raw) are not included. Existing docs summarize or refer to these; a reference does not mean raw bytes were transferred.

scope_notes: files covers current handoff materials and preserved previous capsule; baseline_files independently covers the exact 154 C14 members.
TRANSFER_MANIFEST.json deliberately excludes itself; Git commit identity anchors its bytes.
Existing historical documents and controls remain as evidence, not as new-machine execution permissions.
The full library still needs P2996-capable Clang/libc++; storage-only C++17 validation is separate.
A transfer-integrity pass is not a Mac build, compatibility, sanitizer or performance result.
